about.sectionSubtitle: Sports Scientist. UEFA Football Coach. Strength & Conditioning Coach.
about.intro: I am a Strength & Conditioning Coach, UEFA C Football Coach (UEFA B in progress), and Personal Trainer with experience in professional football, youth development, and high-performance environments. I am currently the U23 Strength & Conditioning Coach at Rayo Vallecano, and I coach and oversee physical preparation at CDE Fuenlabrada Atlantis in Madrid, alongside my work as a Personal Trainer at Funziona – BASIC-FIT.

academic.title: Academic Foundation
academic.body: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Sport Science and Physical Activity and a Master's degree in High Performance in Sport, specializing in Strength and Conditioning. My education allows me to apply scientific principles in strength development, load monitoring, injury prevention, return-to-play, performance analysis, and long-term athlete development.

coaching.title: Coaching Philosophy
coaching.body: I believe every player needs an individualized approach to reach their full potential. I design each session with a clear purpose, combining tactical development, physical preparation, and mental resilience. My coaching is built on evidence-based methods, measurable progress, discipline, teamwork, and the long-term development of every athlete.

vision.title: Professional Vision
vision.body: My goal is to continue developing as a UEFA Football Coach and Strength & Conditioning professional in ambitious, high-performance environments. Building on my experience with youth academies in Spain and Tunisia, El Palmar CF's first team in the 3ª RFEF, and the Syrian U20 National Team, I want to help players improve their performance, reduce injury risk, and achieve their full potential.

items.title: Personal Training
items.description: I design individualized training programs to improve strength, fitness, health, and overall performance. I adapt every program to the client's goals and level, focusing on correct technique, progressive overload, and sustainable long-term results.

items.title: Football Coaching
items.description: As a UEFA C licensed Football Coach, I plan and deliver technical, tactical, and physical training for both individual players and teams. I use a player-centred approach to improve decision-making, game understanding, teamwork, and long-term development.

items.title: Strength & Conditioning
items.description: I develop evidence-based strength and conditioning programs adapted to each athlete's age, level, position, and competition demands. My work focuses on strength and power development, load monitoring, injury prevention, return-to-play, and maximizing athletic performance.
